Differences from TFC: 与群峦传说本体的区别
Firmalife makes a few changes to how thi: Firmalife 模组对群峦传说原版中的一些运作机制进行了改动。本章旨在帮助你了解那些差异较大的方面。
$(l:firmalife/cheese)Cheese$() is made t: $(l:firmalife/cheese)奶酪$()的制作流程更为复杂。它能被作为方块放置，也可以选择在$(l:firmalife/cellar)地窖$()中进行熟化。
$(l:firmalife/bread)Bread$() is made thr: $(l:firmalife/bread)面包$()的制作流程更为复杂，将需要酵母和甜味剂。群峦传说原版的面包配方制作出的是营养价值更低的粗饼。
Firmalife has a greater emphasis on suga: Firmalife 更强调糖的使用。虽然仍然可以从甘蔗中获取糖，但请考虑使用蜂蜜（来自蜜蜂）或用甜菜制糖！
Making $(thing)cheese$() in Firmalife is: Making $(thing)cheese$() in Firmalife is a little more involved than in vanilla TFC. There are two new kinds of milk: $(thing)Yak Milk$(), and $(thing)Goat Milk$(). These are obtained from milking the $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#yak)Yak$() and $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#goat)Goat$(), respectively. Milking the $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#cow)Cow$() still produces the old kind of milk.
Like usual, milk must be $(thing)curdled: Like usual, milk must be $(thing)curdled$() first. To curdle milk, you need $(thing)Rennet$(). Rennet comes from the stomach of $(thing)Ruminant$() animals. This includes $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#yak)Yaks$(), $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#cow)Cows$(), $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#sheep)Sheep$(), $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#goat)Goats$(), and $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#musk_ox)Musk Oxen$(). To curdle milk, seal it in a $(l:mechanics/barrels)Barrel$() with Rennet for 4 hours.
Curdled milk must be converted to $(thin: 凝固后的奶和$(thing)奶酪布$()一起密封在大桶中就可以制成$(thing)凝乳$()。奶酪布是不能重复使用的。
You are ready to make $(thing)Dry Cheese: 现在你可以制造$(thing)干酪$()了。你可以用$(thing)牦牛奶凝乳$()制作$(thing)西藏干酪$()，用$(thing)山羊奶凝乳$()制作$(thing)法式干酪$()，以及用$(thing)牛奶凝乳$()制作$(thing)英格兰切达干酪$()。
Your other option is to make $(thing)Wet: Your other option is to make $(thing)Wet Cheeses$(). These are made by sealing the curds in a barrel of $(thing)Salt Water$(). You can make $(thing)Shosha$() from $(thing)Yak Curds$(), $(thing)Feta$() from $(thing)Goat Curds$(), and $(thing)Gouda$() from $(thing)Milk Curds$().
Cheese wheels are blocks that should be: Cheese wheels are blocks that should be placed in order to help them last. To improve their quality and shelf life, cheese wheels should be $(thing)Aged$() in a $(l:firmalife/cellar)Cellar$(). In order to obtain edible cheese from a cheese wheel, it should be sliced off the wheel by clicking $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with a $(thing)Knife$(). If the block is simply broken, the aging is lost!
The aging stages of a wheel of Gouda: $(: 一块荷兰高达干酪轮的熟化阶段：$(thing)新鲜$()、$(thing)熟成$()和$(thing)陈年$()。
The $(thing)Climate Station$() is a bloc: The $(thing)Climate Station$() is a block that manages the $(l:firmalife/greenhouse)Greenhouse$() and the $(l:firmalife/cellar)Cellar$(). When its corresponding multiblock is built correctly, it will show water on its sides. When it is invalid, it will show ice. The Climate Station must be placed on the first level of the multiblock, touching a wall. If it is not touching a wall, you may $(item)$(k:key.use)$() it with a block that is part of the multiblock you are trying to make to tell it what to look for.
The climate station in its valid and inv: 处于有效和无效状态的气象站。
$(li)It updates periodically on its own,: $(li)It updates periodically on its own, or when placed/broken.$()$(li)When a climate station updates, it tells all the blocks inside the multiblock that they can operate. For example, it lets $(l:firmalife/cheese)Cheese$() begin aging.$()$(li)Press $(item)$(k:key.use)$() to force update the Climate Station and the blocks inside the multiblock.
A note about greenhouse construction: Th: A note about greenhouse construction: The largest greenhouse is 31x31x31, centered on the climate station, or 15 blocks in each direction. Centering the climate station in the greenhouse will allow you to take advantage of the full size range. You can also internally subdivide a greenhouse into multiple by using walls and multiple climate stations to make it larger.
The $(thing)Cellar$() is a multiblock de: The $(thing)Cellar$() is a multiblock device controlled by a $(l:firmalife/climate_station)Climate Station$(). The Cellar multiblock's only requirement is that it be in an enclosed area surrounded by $(thing)Sealed Bricks$() or $(thing)Sealed Brick Doors$() on all sides. The Climate Station must be placed on the first level of the cellar, touching a wall.
This is just one of many cellars that yo: 这只是你可以建造的无数种地窖的一个例子!
$(thing)Beeswax$() is obtained from $(l:: $(thing)蜂蜡$()可以通过$(l:firmalife/beekeeping)养蜂$()获得。$(br)地窖可用于$(l:firmalife/cheese#aging)奶酪熟化$()。
The cellar is used for food preservation: The cellar is used for food preservation, for example by using $(l:firmalife/food_shelves)Food Shelves$() and $(l:firmalife/hangers)Hangers$(). The cellar performs better in environments with cooler average temperatures for food preservation. Below 0 degrees, decay modifiers work slightly better. Below -12 degrees, they perform much better.
The $(thing)Food Shelf$() is a device fo: The $(thing)Food Shelf$() is a device for storing food. It can only be used in a valid $(l:firmalife/cellar)Cellar$(). Food shelves can contain a full stack of one food item. Adding and removing the item can be done with $(item)$(k:key.use)$(). Items in valid food shelves receive a decay modifier that is better than vessels.
The food shelf is made from planks and l: 食物架由木板和木材制成。
The $(thing)Hanger$() is a device for st: The $(thing)Hanger$() is a device for storing meat or garlic. It can only be used in a valid $(l:firmalife/cellar)Cellar$(). Food shelves can contain a full stack of one item. Adding and removing the item can be done with $(item)$(k:key.use)$(). Items in valid food shelves receive a decay modifier that is better than shelves or vessels.
The hanger is made from planks and strin: 悬挂架由木板和线制成。
The jarbnet is a cosmetic storage block: The jarbnet is a cosmetic storage block for $(l:tfc:mechanics/jarring)Jars$(), Candles, and Jugs. It can be opened and closed by clicking with an empty hand and $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() pressed. If candles are inside, it can be lit to produce a small amount of light.
The $(thing)Greenhouse$() is a multibloc: The $(thing)Greenhouse$() is a multiblock device controlled by a $(l:firmalife/climate_station)Climate Station$(). It allows growing crops year round. The Greenhouse has an array of types and blocks to choose from. However, building a greenhouse is quite simple. Like the $(l:firmalife/cellar)Cellar$(), it should be an enclosed area of blocks belonging to the same $(thing)Greenhouse Type$(). The floor of the greenhouse may be non-air block.
The walls of greenhouses must be solid f: The walls of greenhouses must be solid faces. Panel walls should be placed so that the face that is on the exterior of the block (eg. the face you can place a torch on) faces into the greenhouse. The same applies for roofs, except that slabs are always considered valid roof blocks. Trapdoors and doors are also always valid and require no special placement.
$(thing)Greenhouse Types$() are families: $(thing)Greenhouse Types$() are families of greenhouse blocks that can be used interchangeably in a greenhouse. Most greenhouse blocks $(thing)age$(). For example, $(thing)Treated Wood$() greenhouse blocks become $(thing)Weathered Treated Wood$() blocks. Since both of those block types belong to the same greenhouse type, your greenhouse will continue to function.
These are the $(thing)Greenhouse Types$(: 以下是所有的$(thing)温室类型$()及其可能老化成的方块类型：$(br)$(br)$(li)防腐木：风化 的$()$(li)铜：斑驳的、风化的、氧化的$()$(li)铁：生锈的$() $(li)不锈钢（不会老化）$()
There are four types of regular $(thing): There are four types of regular $(thing)Greenhouse Blocks$(): Walls, Doors, Roofs, and Roof Tops. Roofs and Roof Tops are stairs and slabs, respectively. There are also thinner versions of these blocks, also known as panel walls, trapdoors, and panel roofs. These can be combined however you choose to form the structure of the greenhouse.
An example greenhouse, in each main type: 每种类型的温室的一个范例。
There are many blocks that operate insid: 有许多方块可以在温室内运作：$(br)$(li)$(l:firmalife/planters)种植盆$()，用于种植作物$()，以及$(br)$(li)$(l:firmalife/irrigation)洒水器$()，为种植盆供水的各种装置。
The next four pages contain recipes for: The next four pages contain recipes for the main greenhouse block types. While they are only shown for Iron greenhouses, the iron rods in the recipe can be replaced with $(thing)Treated Lumber$(), $(thing)Copper Rods$(), or $(thing)Stainless Steel Rods$(). For information on Stainless Steel, see $(l:firmalife/stainless_steel)this linked page$().
The $(thing)Sprinkler$() is a device tha: $(thing)洒水器$()是一种以洒水器方块正下方为中心，对5x6x5区域进行灌溉的装置。当它周围有水的粒子效果时，表明它正在工作。面朝上放置的洒水器会对上方相同的5x6x5区域进行灌溉。
The sprinkler is made with a $(thing)Cop: 洒水器由一块$(thing)铜板$()锻造而成。
Sprinklers must be connected to a system: Sprinklers must be connected to a system of pipes that feed it water in order to work. This is done by connecting a series of $(thing)Copper Pipes$() to them. Copper Pipes transport water up to 32 blocks to a sprinkler. They are connected to $(thing)Irrigation Tanks$() or $(thing)Pumping Stations$().
铜制管道是由铜板制成的。
Pumping stations must be above a source: Pumping stations must be above a source block of water in order to work, and be connected to mechanical power. Irrigation tanks can also serve water through their ports on the sides, provided that they are stacked at most 3 blocks high above a pumping station on other tanks.
Oxidized pipes are the same as regular c: 氧化管道与普通铜制管道功能相同，只是不能与另一种类型的管道连接。
Greenhouse ports have a single pipe insi: 温室端口内部设有一根管道，可用于使水流贯通温室墙壁！
$(thing)Planters$() are used to grow cro: $(thing)Planters$() are used to grow crops inside a $(l:firmalife/greenhouse)Greenhouse$(). To see the status of a planter, you can look at it while holding a $(thing)Hoe$(). Crops in planters consume $(l:mechanics/fertilizers)Nutrients$() in a similar way to $(l:mechanics/crops)Crops$(). Planters should be placed inside a valid Greenhouse and activated with a $(l:firmalife/climate_station)Climate Station$(). Planters need at least some natural sunlight to work.
Planters must be $(thing)Watered$() to g: Planters must be $(thing)Watered$() to grow. This is done with a $(thing)Watering Can$(), crafted from a $(thing)Wooden Bucket$(), a container of $(thing)Water$() and $(thing)Lumber$(). Press $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with it to water nearby planters. Refill it by pressing $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on a water source.
$(thing)Large Planters$() are the most s: $(thing)大型种植盆$()是最简单的一种种植盆。它们从单粒种子开始种植一株作物，成熟后可使用$(item)$(k:key.use)$()收获。
Large Planters can grow $(thing)Green Be: 大型种植盆可以种植$(thing)绿豆$()、$(thing)西红柿$()、$(thing)甘蔗$()、$(thing)黄麻$()和$(thing)谷物$()。但如果要种植谷物，你需要一个$(thing)铜$()或更高等级的温室。
$(thing)Quad Planters$() grow four indiv: $(thing)四槽种植盆$()可以同时种植四株作物。这些作物都会从同一个养料池汲取营养，成熟后可分别使用$(item)$(k:key.use)$()来单独收获。
Quad Planters can grow $(thing)Beets$(),: 四槽种植盆可以种植$(thing)甜菜$()、$(thing)卷心菜$()、$(thing)胡萝卜$()、$(thing)大蒜$()、$(thing)洋葱$()、$(thing)马铃薯$()和$(thing)大豆$()。这些农作物都可以在任意等级的温室中种植。
$(thing)Bonsai Planters$() grow small fr: $(thing)盆栽种植盆$()可以用树苗来种植小型果树。按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()就可以收获水果。
Bonsai Planters can grow any fruit tree: 盆栽种植盆可以种植除$(thing)香蕉$()外的任何果树，而香蕉需要$(thing)悬挂种植盆$()。它们都会消耗氮作为主要的营养，并且需要$(thing)铁$()或更高等级的温室才能种植。
$(thing)Hanging Planters$() grow crops u: $(thing)悬挂种植盆$()可以倒着种植农作物。成熟后可以按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()收获。
Hanging Planters grow $(thing)Squash$(),: Hanging Planters grow $(thing)Squash$(), from their seeds, and $(thing)Bananas$(), from their saplings. Squash can be grown in any greenhouse, but Bananas require an $(thing)Iron$() or better greenhouse to grow. Hanging planters need to anchor to a solid block above them.
$(thing)Trellis Planters$() grow berry b: $(thing)格子种植架$()可以种植各种浆果丛。浆果可以按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()收获。
Trellis Planters have the unique propert: Trellis Planters have the unique property of $(thing)propagating$() berry bushes. If a trellis planter is placed on top of another, and the one below has a mature berry bush, it has a chance to grow upwards into the next one. Trellis planters can grow any berry bush except $(thing)Cranberries$(), but require an $(thing)Iron$() or better greenhouse to work. Bushes prefer Nitrogen.
$(thing)Hydroponic Planters$() grow rice: $(thing)水培种植盆$()用于种植水稻和蔓越莓。其运作方式与四格种植盆相同，只是无需浇水。
Hydroponic Planters must instead, have a: 水培种植盆必须在其下方安装一根$(li)$(l:firmalife/irrigation)洒水器管道$()来提供水源。没有这根管道，作物将无法生长。每个水泵操作站可以供给的水培种植园没有严格的数量限制。
$(thing)Sweepers$() are used to harvest: $(thing)清扫器$()用于收割四槽种植盆和水培种植盆以外的种植盆。其底部必须连接一个旋转的$(thing)传动轴$()。
$(thing)Pickers$() can be powered via re: $(thing)采摘器$()可通过上方的红石信号激活。它会向下延伸，以采集四槽种植盆和水培种植盆中的作物。
$(thing)Beehives$() are a place to house: $(thing)Beehives$() are a place to house bees. Beehives need $(thing)Beehive Frames$() inside them for the bees to live. Removing frames from an active hive will cause the bees to attack you, unless done at night, or with a $(thing)Firepit$() underneath the hive active. Beehives can share flowers. The benefit of flowers diminishes after 60 flowers.
Beehives know about the area in a 5 bloc: Beehives know about the area in a 5 block radius from them. If there are at least 10 flowers around the hive, there is a chance an empty frame will be populated with a $(thing)Queen$(). This is indicated by bee particles flying around the hive. Having 4 empty frames in a hive greatly increases the chances of bees moving in.
If a beehive has two frames with queens,: If a beehive has two frames with queens, and an empty frame, the two colonies have a chance of $(thing)Breeding$() and producing a new queen in the empty frame. This has the effect of passing on the $(thing)Abilities$() of each parent to the offspring. Abilities are different traits bees have that change how they effect the world around them. They are on a scale of 1-10, with 10 being the max.
Bees also produce $(thing)Honey$(). Usin: 蜜蜂还会产出$(thing)蜂蜜$()。手持空罐子对一个存有蜂蜜的蜂箱使用$(item)$(k:key.use)$()，可以获得一个$(thing)蜂蜜罐$()。打开蜂蜜罐可获得$(thing)生蜂蜜$()，它是$(thing)糖$()的替代品。
Pressing $(item)$(k:key.use)$() a filled: 手持$(thing)刀$()在物品栏中对一个满的巢脾按下$(item)$(k:key.use)$()，可以获得$(thing)蜂蜡$()，其用途广泛。但请注意，这会杀死巢脾内的蜂王，务必小心操作！
The most important use of beeswax is in: 蜂蜡最重要的用途是制作$(thing)防腐木材$()。
$(li)Bees can help fertilize planters!$(: $(li)蜜蜂可以帮种植盆施肥！$()$(li)刮取巢脾会牺牲其中的蜂王。请明智操作！$()$(li)身体处于潮湿状态可以防止蜜蜂攻击你。$()
$(li)$(thing)Hardiness$(): Allows bees t: $(li)$(thing)Hardiness$(): Allows bees to produce honey at lower temperatures. Hardiness 10 allows up to -16°C, whereas Hardiness 1 allows up to 2°C.$()$(li)$(thing)Production$(): Improves the speed of honey production.$()$(li)$(thing)Mutant$(): Increases variability in the traits passed during breeding$().
$(li)$(thing)Fertility$(): Increases lik: $(li)$(thing)Fertility$(): Increases likelihood of breeding.$()$(li)$(thing)Crop Affinity$(): Likelihood of spreading a small amount of nutrients to crops.$()$(li)$(thing)Nature Restoration$(): Causes new flowers and lilypads to spawn around the hive.$()$(li)$(thing)Calmness$(): Decreases likelihood of bees attacking you$().
Bees with high Mutant ability have a cha: 具有高突变性特性的蜜蜂有可能患上$(thing)遗传病$()。患病的蜜蜂会将疾病遗传给后代，并且不会产蜜。
$(thing)Stainless Steel$() and $(thing)C: $(thing)不锈钢$()和$(thing)铬$()是Firmalife模组添加的$(thing)钢级$()金属。它们用于建造$(l:firmalife/greenhouse)不锈钢温室$()。
Chromite is an ore that is melted to obt: 铬铁矿是一种熔炼后可获得铬的矿石。它存在于$(thing)侵入岩$()和$(thing)变质岩$()中。
$(li)Granite$()$(li)Diorite$()$(li)Gabbr: $(li)花岗岩$()$(li)闪长岩$()$(li)辉长岩$()$(li)板岩$()$(li)千枚岩$()$(li)片岩$()$(li)片麻岩$()$(li)大理岩$()
All Chromium Rocks: 所有可能含铬的岩石种类
The $(thing)Drying Mat$() is used to dry: $(thing)干燥垫$()是用来干燥物品的。它使用$(thing)果树叶子$()制成，果树叶子可以打碎$(thing)果树$()的叶子得到。
To use the drying mat, place it out on t: 干燥垫需要放置在阳光下，手持物品对其按下$(item)$(k:key.use)$()即可将物品放上去。经过半天时间，物品即可被晒干。如果中途下雨，干燥过程就必须重新开始。
The solar drier functions the same as th: 太阳能干燥器的功能与干燥垫相同，但速度是干燥垫的12倍。
Drying mats can be automated. Pushing a: 干燥垫能够实现自动化。使用活塞头推撞干燥垫会弹出物品，将物品丢在干燥垫上则会将其放置。
Drying fruit is a common use of the dryi: 干燥垫一般用来晾干水果。干燥的水果有更长的保质期，并且在某些配方中会用到。
豆腐需要用干燥垫制作。
肉桂需要用干燥垫制作。
Wool string is used to hang items for $(: 羊毛纱用于悬挂物品以进行$(thing)熏制$()。按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()即可放置羊毛纱。
Smoking is used to preserve $(thing)Meat: Smoking is used to preserve $(thing)Meat$() and $(l:mechanics/dairy)Cheese$(). To smoke meat, it must have first been $(thing)Brined$() by sealing it in a $(thing)Barrel$() with $(thing)Brine$(). You may also salt it first. Cheese does not have this requirement.
To start the smoking process, add the it: To start the smoking process, add the item to the string above a firepit. The firepit must be within four blocks, directly underneath the string. The string should begin to generate some smoke if it is working. It is important to note that the firepit must only be burned with $(thing)Logs$(). Using something like $(thing)Peat$() will instantly give your food the $(thing)Disgusting$() trait!
The smoking process takes 8 in-game hour: 熏制过程需要游戏内的8小时。熏制愉快！
$(thing)Ovens$() are a great way of cook: $(thing)Ovens$() are a great way of cooking lots of food in a way that improves their shelf life. Oven-baked food decays at 90% of the rate of regular food. Ovens are a multiblock structure consisting of a $(thing)Bottom Oven$(), $(thing)Top Oven$(), and optionally $(thing)Chimneys$(). These blocks start off as clay, and must be $(thing)Cured$() by raising their temperature to a certain amount for long enough.$(br)$(l:firmalife/oven_appliances)Oven Appliances$() extend oven functionality.
Ovens are insulated with $(thing)Bricks$: 烤炉可以用$(thing)砖块$()、其他烤炉方块或任何能为木炭炉保温的方块进行包裹。这意味着你也可以使用石块，如果你愿意的话！
The $(thing)Peel$() is the only safe way: $(thing)烤炉铲$()是从烤炉中取出炙热物品的安全方式。手持烤炉铲对烤炉$(item)$(k:key.use)$()即可取出物品。否则你会被烫伤！
The Oven first consists of the Top Oven: The Oven first consists of the Top Oven placed on top of the Bottom Oven. All sides of each oven part, besides the front face, should then be covered with Oven Insulation blocks, as covered two pages ago. You may choose to use $(thing)Oven Chimneys$() as insulation. Placing a stack of chimneys directly behind the oven causes the smoke from the oven to travel up and out of it. If you don't do this, smoke will quickly fill up your house, which is very distracting!
An example oven structure, uncured and c: 烤炉的一个示例，包括未硬化的和硬化的。
The Bottom Oven is used to hold fuel, wh: The Bottom Oven is used to hold fuel, which may only be logs. Press $(item)$(k:key.use)$() to add or remove them. The bottom oven is also the part of the oven which may be lit with a $(thing)Firestarter$() or other tool. It transfers heat contained in it to the top oven.
The Top Oven contains the items that are: The Top Oven contains the items that are being cooked. It will draw heat from the Bottom Oven and slowly release it over time. This means that even if your fuel runs out, your Top Oven can continue to work for a little while. Adding items to it is as simple as pressing $(item)$(k:key.use)$(). Remember to use a $(thing)Peel$() to remove the items after.
Curing Oven blocks is easy, but requires: Curing Oven blocks is easy, but requires patience. Simply start running your Bottom Oven as you would normally, and then wait. If an oven block is above 600 degrees for about 80 seconds, it will cure itself and any oven blocks around it. The curing effect will pass all the way up chimneys nearby.
Crafting oven insulation for your Bottom: 为你的烤炉底合成烤炉隔热层，可以让你无需再在其侧面和背面进行隔热。但这并不免除对烟囱的需求。按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()来应用它。
Countertops are aesthetic blocks that co: 台面是装饰性方块，可以算作烤炉隔热层，且外观与烤炉方块相匹配。它们是你厨房装饰的绝佳选择。
Ovens also have $(thing)Finishes$() that: Ovens also have $(thing)Finishes$() that can be used to change their appearance. These finishes are applied to the basic brick stage of the oven (or brick blocks themselves), and are cosmetic. Finishes can be mixed and matched. They are applied with $(item)$(k:key.use)$().
$(l:firmalife/ovens)Ovens$() have a numb: $(l:firmalife/ovens)烤炉$()有多种设备可以与其交互，从而扩展其功能。这是因为烤炉在现实中本就是模块化的。
The $(thing)Oven Hopper$() will input lo: $(thing)烤炉漏斗$()会向其朝向的任何$(thing)烤炉底$()输入原木。它最多可容纳16根原木（4组，每组4根，类似一个原木堆），通过从顶部丢入物品来填充其物品栏，也可以通过其他模组的自动化设备输入。
The $(thing)Ashtray$() collects $(thing): $(thing)炉灰收集器$()放置在$(thing)烤炉底$()下方时，会收集$(thing)草木灰$()。当燃料消耗时，有50%的几率获得草木灰。通过$(item)$(k:key.use)$()可以取出草木灰，通过攻击（左键点击）可以放入草木灰。
The $(thing)Vat$() produces some select: $(thing)不锈钢锅$()能够批量制作某些特定的煮沸配方。它有一个物品槽位和10,000mB的流体存储空间，类似于一个大木桶。
For example, the vat can be used to make: For example, the vat can be used to make $(thing)Olive Oil Water$() using a ratio of 1 Olive Paste to 200 mB Water. To use a vat, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() it with fluids and items to add them to the inventory. With an empty hand and $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() held, click to seal and unseal the vat. A vat will not boil until it is sealed.
Vats should be placed on the block above: Vats should be placed on the block above a $(thing)Bottom Oven$(). If the vat would overflow on completion of the recipe, it will not boil, so be sure not to overfill it -- especially with recipes that produce more fluid than they consume! Vats can be opened and closed with $(thing)Redstone$().
The $(thing)Jarring Station$() is used t: $(thing)装罐台$()用于将不锈钢锅中的流体装入罐子中。装罐台侧面的注嘴必须对准装罐台方向放置。
Using the Vat, Sugar Water can be made b: Using the Vat, Sugar Water can be made by adding sweetener to water. Then, adding fruit causes $(thing)Fruity Fluid$() to be made. Clicking it with an $(thing)Empty Jar With Lid$() will fill it. Be careful: trying to pipe or transport fruity fluid through too many transfers could ruin it!
With $(item)$(k:key.use)$(), add empty j: 使用$(item)$(k:key.use)$()将带盖的空罐添加到装罐台。当检测到果酱时，它会自动将空罐子填充为$(thing)果酱$()并密封，每罐需要消耗500mB果酱。
Pots and Grills from TFC can be placed o: 群峦传说模组的陶锅与烤架可放置于$(thing)烤炉底$()上方，它们会自动从烤炉底获取热量。不过，放置在此的陶锅仅能用于制作汤，无法执行常规的陶锅配方。
To make $(thing)Bread$(), one first must: To make $(thing)Bread$(), one first must get $(thing)Yeast$(). To get your first yeast, seal $(l:firmalife/drying)Dried Fruit$() in a Barrel of $(thing)Water$(). After three days, $(thing)Yeast Starter$() will form.$(br)From now on, your yeast can be fed by sealing Yeast Starter in a Barrel with $(thing)Flour$(). This causes it to multiply. 1 flour per 100mB of Yeast produces 600mB of Yeast. That's a good deal!
Yeast Starter, Sweetener, and Flour can: 将酵种、甜味剂和面粉混合，可以制成$(thing)面团$()。像平常一样把面团烤熟，就能做出$(thing)面包$()了！
Once baked, you can use a $(thing)knife$: 面包烤好后，可以用$(thing)刀$()将其切成$(thing)面包片$()。这些面包片可用于$(l:tfc:mechanics/sandwiches)制作三明治$()，或者烤成$(thing)吐司$()，然后涂抹上$(thing)黄油$()或果酱。
Given a greater need for fertilization i: 鉴于 Firmalife 对施肥有更高的需求，这里提供了更多获取$(l:mechanics/fertilizers)肥料$()的途径。
Thatch can be $(l:firmalife/drying)Dried: 茅草可以$(l:firmalife/drying)晒干$()成$(thing)干草$()，它可以在堆肥桶中作为一种棕色物品使用。
$(thing)Compost Tumblers$() are a great: $(thing)堆肥滚筒$()是生产更多肥料的绝佳方式。它必须连接上动力才能工作，且只能在未供能时才能被玩家操作，因此可以考虑为其连接一个离合器！
The compost tumbler is unique in that it: 堆肥滚筒的独特之处在于它可以处理更多类型的堆肥原料，并且不需要精确的比例即可运作。
The tumbler can take green and brown ite: 滚筒可以像普通的堆肥桶一样接收绿色和棕色的物品。它也可以少量接收陶片、木炭、鱼和骨头。
Smashing pottery with a hammer yields sh: 用锤子砸碎陶器可获得碎片。
Green and brown items count the same, be: Green and brown items count the same, being on the range 1-4, but the new additions like fish always count for 1. Adding too much weird stuff to the composter causes it to produce rotten compost. Further, you will not know it is rotten until the very end! If the compost is more than fifteen percent bones, fish, or pottery, or more than twenty percent charcoal. it will rot. Or, if there are 10 or more green units than brown units, it will rot.
Favorable amounts of certain additions c: Favorable amounts of certain additions can extend or shorten the length of time it takes for the compost to complete. Play around with it and see what happens.$(br)If 32 units are in the composter, 3 compost will be produced. If at least 24, 2 compost will be made. If 16 or more, 1 will be made. Below that, and there will be no compost.
The mixing bowl is a way of mixing items: 搅拌碗是把物品和液体混合在一起的好方法。拿一个$(thing)勺子$()对它$(item)$(k:key.use)$()就可以把勺子放进碗里, 然后搅拌碗就可以使用了。
需要一个$(thing)勺子$()才能使用。
In Firmalife, there are a number of smal: In Firmalife, there are a number of small plants you can collect and grow on your own, which have cooking properties. The easiest way to obtain these plants is with a $(thing)Seed Ball$(). To use a $(thing)Seed Ball$(), just $(item)$(k:key.use)$() to throw it, like a snowball. This will spawn $(thing)Butterfly Grass$() in the area.
The recipe for the seed ball requires $(: 种子球的合成配方需要$(l:firmalife/more_fertilizer)堆肥$()和4个$(thing)种子$()。
Butterfly grass will mature over time. W: 蝴蝶草会随着时间的推移而成熟。当其成熟后，会有几率传播到周围的方块，或转变为新的植物。由其他草方块扩散而来的蝴蝶草方块则不会再传播。
Basil is one of the plants that can be s: 罗勒是蝴蝶草可能生成的植物之一。
罗勒叶可以用来制作披萨。
Firmalife adds some fruiting plants on t: Firmalife在群峦传说原有的基础上新增了一些结果植物。
To improve readability, entries start on: 为了提高可读性，正文将从下一页开始。
$(bold)$(l:the_world/climate#temperature: $(bold)$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)温度$(): 20 - 35 °C$(br)$(bold)$(l:mechanics/hydration)降雨量$(): 220 - 400mm$(br2)可可树用于制作$(l:firmalife/chocolate)巧克力$()。
The monthly stages of a Cocoa tree: 可可树的月度生长阶段
The monthly stages of a Fig tree: 无花果树的月度生长阶段
Firmalife adds some berry bushes. For in: Firmalife 模组新增了一些浆果丛。关于野生葡萄藤的信息，请参阅$(l:firmalife/wine)酿酒$()指南。
First is nightshade. Nightshade is a poi: 首先是龙葵。龙葵是一种有毒浆果。放入汤中可制成带毒性的$(thing)恶臭毒汤$()。它生成于年降雨量200-400毫米、气温7-24℃的森林地带。
Pineapple bushes are found 250-500mm of: 菠萝灌木丛能在降雨量介于250-500mm之间与温度介于20-32摄氏度区间内的森林中找到。菠萝特性基本与其他水果一致，除了它们能被制作成 $(thing)菠萝布$()。
Pineapples that have been $(l:firmalife/: $(l:tfc:firmalife/drying)晒干$()的菠萝能被制成菠萝纤维。
Pineapple yarn is made by crafting a $(t: 菠萝线是通过使用$(thing)纺锤$()与菠萝纤维合成得到的。
Finally, pineapple leather can be me wov: 最后，菠萝布能在$(l:tfc:mechanics/weaving)织机$()中被加工。它是普通皮革的植物替代品，可用于装饰、合成或其他用途！
$(thing)Chocolate-making$() takes a few: $(thing)Chocolate-making$() takes a few processing steps, for not much of a reward. It's important to remember, when playing Firmalife, that being a chocolatier is for your personal enjoyment and pleasure, rather than for trying to extract maximum value from any given input.
To start chocolate processing, cocoa bea: To start chocolate processing, cocoa beans must first be $(thing)roasted$() in an $(l:firmalife/ovens)Oven$() to make $(thing)Roasted Cocoa Beans$(). Then, craft the roasted beans with a $(thing)Knife$() to split the beans into $(thing)Cocoa Powder$() and $(thing)Cocoa Powder$().
The $(l:firmalife/mixing_bowl)Mixing Bow: The $(l:firmalife/mixing_bowl)Mixing Bowl$() is used to mix cocoa powder, butter, and sweetener (sugar or honey) to make $(thing)Chocolate Blends$(). The ratio of cocoa butter to powder determines what comes out:$(br)$(li)1 Powder, 1 Butter, 1 Sweetener: Milk Chocolate$()$(li)2 Powder, 1 Sweetener: Dark Chocolate$()$(li)2 Butter, 1 Sweetener: White Chocolate$()
Finally, chocolate is dried on a $(l:fir: 最后，将巧克力放在$(l:firmalife/drying)干燥垫$()上干燥，制成$(thing)巧克力$()。
$(thing)Winemaking$() is the science of: $(thing)Winemaking$() is the science of turning grapes into alcohol. There is time spent gathering resources, and spending time crafting those resources together, as well as time spent $(thing)enjoying$() the product. Please note that wine in Firmalife (on its own) has no special use beyond regular TFC alcohol. You should make it only if you want to have $(thing)fun$().
Red grapes spawn from 0-30 C, and 125-50: 红葡萄生成于0-30°C、125-500降雨量的区域，几乎覆盖了整个宜居区。
White grapes spawn from 0-30 C, and 125-: 白葡萄生成于0-30°C、125-500降雨量的区域，几乎覆盖了整个宜居区。
Grapes must be grown on trellises constr: 葡萄必须生长在由这些特殊柱子和黄麻纤维搭建的葡萄架上。
To construct a trellis, place two posts: To construct a trellis, place two posts on top of each other. Move two blocks to the left or right and repeat the action. Then, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() the side of one of the top and bottom posts with $(thing)Jute Fiber$() to string lines between the posts. Grape trellises can be chained horizontally to create rows of grapes.
Provided the climate requirements are sa: Provided the climate requirements are satisfied, the grape will grow up and over the trellis over the course of a few months. It will fruit in the month of July, flowering the month prior. Grapes can the be harvested. Grapes can also be grown in greenhouses on trellises.
The stomping barrel is used to smash gra: 踩踏桶用于捣碎葡萄。手推磨也可用于此目的。
To use a stomping barrel, $(item)$(k:key: To use a stomping barrel, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with fresh grapes. Then, jump up and down on the barrel 16 times. $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with an empty hand to retrieve the items.$(br2)Then, seal the grapes in a barrel for 5 days to $(thing)ferment$() them.
The barrel press is the last step in gra: 压榨桶是葡萄加工的最后一步。
The leftmost slot can contain up to 16 g: The leftmost slot can contain up to 16 grapes. Four grape items are needed for a bottle of wine. The four central slots are for mixing the grapes with other ingredients, but this is optional. Using only red or white grapes yields red or white wine. Adding at least one red grape to white wine makes Rose. Adding sugar to white wine makes dessert wine. Adding tirage mixture (yeast and sweetener in a barrel) makes sparkling wine.
Wine must be bottled in a proper wine bo: 葡萄酒必须装入由非硅酸盐玻璃制成的专用酒瓶中。
$(thing)Bottle labels$() can be renamed: $(thing)瓶子标签$()可在抄写台中重命名，其名称将添加到葡萄酒的物品提示信息中。
Wine must be provided with a $(thing)Cor: 葡萄酒需配备一个$(thing)软木塞$()，其制作方法是将$(thing)防腐木材$()在$(thing)石灰水$()中浸泡一天。一切就绪后，使用酒瓶槽位灌装葡萄酒，或手持酒瓶$(item)$(k:key.use)$()进行灌装。
The discerning sommelier will be able to: The discerning sommelier will be able to detect subtleties in the wine that is produced under different conditions. Indeed, this is possible in the world of Firmalife as well. It starts in the fields in which those grapes were grown -- a row of grapes is deeply affected by the ambient environment and soil.
Grapes can have three terrain related tr: Grapes can have three terrain related traits -- 'Gravel Grown', 'Slope Grown', and 'Dirt Grown', based on the environment nearby. Wine also records the Koppen Climate Classification of the area in which it is bottled. Grapes grown near bees have the 'Bee Pollinated' trait.
Wine begins aging as soon as it is bottl: Wine begins aging as soon as it is bottled, and stops aging when the cork is removed. The cork can be removed by $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on the bottle item with a knife item. Otherwise, wine bottles work a little like buckets, and can be emptied into barrels or other devices.
The $(thing)Keg$() is a 2x2x2 barrel blo: $(thing)酿造桶$()是一种2x2x2规格的桶状方块，能够储存大量物品或流体，实乃酿酒工坊的完美配置。
The $(thing)Wine Shelf$() is the perfect: $(thing)酒架$()是酒窖的理想配套装饰，让你能以典雅方式陈列与储存珍酿。
Firmalife allows the creation of a varie: Firmalife 允许制作各式各样的美味烘焙食品。本章将为你提供所需的一切知识，让你开始为早餐、午餐和晚餐享用美味而富有创意的餐点。
$(thing)Butter is the base of many such: $(thing)Butter is the base of many such foods. Using a $(l:firmalife/mixing_bowl)Mixing Bowl$(), combine 1000 mB of $(thing)Cream$() with one item of $(thing)Salt$(). Cream is made by sealing 1000 mB of milk in a barrel with a $(l:mechanics/firmalife#cheesecloth)Cheesecloth$().
One useful meal is the $(thing)Pie$(). I: One useful meal is the $(thing)Pie$(). In your mixing bowl, combine butter, flower, and a sweetener (sugar, honey) to make $(thing)Pie Dough$(). To directly make $(thing)Pumpkin Pie$(), mix in an egg, two pumpkin chunks, flour, and sweetener. Craft it with a $(thing)Pie Pan$() and bake it in an $(l:firmalife/ovens)Oven$() to complete the recipe.
$(thing)Pie Pans$() can be smithed in an: $(thing)馅饼烤盘$()可以在砧上用$(thing)铸铁$()锻造而成。
Pie Dough, Preserves, and a Pie Pan will: 面团、果酱和一个馅饼烤盘可以让你获得一个$(thing)已填充的馅饼$()，随后放入烤炉完成制作，即可得到一个美味的馅饼。
To make $(thing)Pizza$(), mix Dough, Sal: 要制作$(thing)披萨$()，请在$(l:firmalife/mixing_bowl)搅拌碗$()中混合面团、盐、罗勒叶和100 mB油。油可以是橄榄油或大豆油（将大豆酱密封在一桶水中制成的产物）。
You'll need some shredded cheese to star: 首先你需要一些奶酪丝。
To make $(thing)Tomato Sauce$(), boil a: 要制作$(thing)番茄酱$()，请把一个番茄、盐、大蒜和水一起在锅中煮沸。或者，使用$(l:firmalife/oven_appliances#vat)不锈钢锅$()煮沸这些原料的合成物，即$(thing)番茄酱混合料$()。
Pizza is made from 1-3 of vegetables, co: 披萨由1-3份蔬菜、熟肉或水果，一份奶酪丝和一份番茄酱制作而成。
There are two types of $(thing)Noodles$(: There are two types of $(thing)Noodles$(): Egg and Rice. Rice flour, maize flour, salt, and 1000 mB of milk together in a $(l:firmalife/mixing_bowl)Mixing Bowl$() makes $(thing)Rice Noodles$(). Flour, an egg, salt, and 1000 mB of milk makes $(thing)Egg Noodles$().
$(thing)Lasagna$() can be made directly: $(thing)千层面$()可以直接用鸡蛋面制作，配料需要$(l:firmalife/pizza#tomato_sauce)番茄酱$()、熟肉和牛至，然后放入$(l:firmalife/ovens)烤炉$()中烘烤。
Pasta is then completed by boiling it in: 制作完成的意大利面需要在水中煮熟。无论是哪种面条，都必须用$(thing)碗$()点击锅才能取出。
Crafting cooked egg noodles (pasta) with: 将煮熟的鸡蛋面（意面）与番茄酱一起合成，就能做出美味的番茄酱意面了！
Burritos and Tacos: 墨西哥卷饼与墨西哥煎饼
The journey of making a $(thing)Tortilla: The journey of making a $(thing)Tortilla$() is a long process, but rewarding. Start with $(thing)Maize Grain$(). Boil it in a pot of $(thing)Limewater$(), and seal it in a barrel of water to make $(thing)Nixtamal$(). Then crush it in a $(thing)Quern$() to make $(thing)Masa Flour$().
Crafting the Masa Flour with a bucket of: 将马萨玉米面粉与一桶水合成即可得到制作薄饼的面团——$(thing)马萨玉米面团$()。加热该面团可制成$(thing)墨西哥薄饼$()，而将薄饼放入烤炉烘烤则会变成$(thing)墨西哥煎饼壳$()。
A tomato, cilantro, salt, and a knife wi: 将番茄、香菜、盐与刀组合即可制成$(thing)莎莎酱$()。
The $(thing)Burrito$() is made from cook: $(thing)墨西哥卷饼$()需用熟肉、$(l:firmalife/pizza#shredded_cheese)奶酪丝$()、$(l:firmalife/pizza#tomato_sauce)番茄酱$()、蔬菜与莎莎酱共同制作。
The $(thing)Taco$() is made from the sam: $(thing)墨西哥煎饼$()原料与之相同，但需使用$(thing)墨西哥煎饼壳$()作为基底。
